$comment: Machine-readable mirror of the .feature files. `id` is the join key to the Playwright test titles; `npm run check:trace` fails CI if the three drift apart.

cases.title: Valid credentials land the user on the dashboard
cases.expected: Logout + add-note visible; URL /notes/app/; token in localStorage

cases.title: Wrong password is rejected and no session is created
cases.expected: Toast 'Incorrect email address or password'; stays on /login; no token stored

cases.title: Unknown email and wrong password are indistinguishable
cases.expected: Identical message; both 401

cases.title: Malformed email is rejected client-side without a network call
cases.expected: Inline 'Email address is invalid'; zero requests to /users/login

cases.title: Forgot password link reaches the recovery form
cases.expected: /forgot-password with editable email and enabled submit

cases.title: A session revoked server-side is sent back to login
cases.expected: After DELETE /users/logout on the browser's token and a reload: redirected to /login

cases.title: Repeated failed logins stay controlled
cases.expected: 5 attempts all 401/429, never 5xx; lockout absence recorded
cases.notes: No lockout exists on this target; asserting one would be a permanent false failure.

cases.title: Password is masked and never sent in the URL
cases.expected: type=password; POST; password absent from request and page URLs

cases.title: Forgot password does not reveal whether an account exists
cases.expected: Generic message for unknown emails

cases.title: Widgets finish loading with no first-party errors
cases.expected: 4 cards, filters, add-note, search, counter; no first-party console errors or failed API calls

cases.title: Rendered notes and progress counter match the API response
cases.expected: Seed == API response == rendered titles; counter 1/4

cases.title: Category filter shows exactly that category's notes
cases.expected: Exactly the seeded notes of that category; counter scoped and correct

cases.title: Returning to "All" restores the original list in the original order
cases.expected: Identical titles, same order

cases.title: Open notes come first by latest update; completing a note moves it down
cases.expected: Order matches the rule; completed note sinks; counter +1

cases.title: Search narrows by title and shows an empty state for no match
cases.expected: Single match for 'dentist'; empty state for no match

cases.title: After logout the dashboard and its data are not reachable by URL
cases.expected: Landing page; no cards, add-note or seeded titles via direct URL

cases.title: A user cannot open another user's note by direct URL
cases.expected: 'No note found'; none of the note's content rendered

cases.title: Primary note controls are usable on a phone
cases.expected: Add-note in viewport; search editable; filter works at 412px

cases.title: Nothing requires horizontal scrolling on a phone
cases.expected: scrollWidth <= clientWidth at 412px

cases.title: Health check reports the service up
cases.expected: 200, envelope with success = true

cases.title: Register, login and profile return schema-valid bodies with a usable token
cases.expected: 201 / 200 / 200, each schema-valid; profile equals registered user

cases.title: Wrong password and unknown email get the identical 401 with no token
cases.expected: 401 ×2, strict error schema, identical messages

cases.title: A protected route rejects a missing token with 401
cases.expected: 401; message names x-auth-token

cases.title: A malformed token is rejected with 401, not a 5xx
cases.expected: 401 for each, never 5xx

cases.title: Note CRUD lifecycle, ending with proof the delete really deleted
cases.request: POST → GET → GET list → PUT → PATCH → DELETE → GET
cases.expected: Each step schema-valid; final GET 404; list empty

cases.title: Invalid note input is rejected with 400 and a field-level message, and nothing is stored
cases.expected: 400 naming the field; nothing stored

cases.title: An unknown note id is 404 and a malformed id is 400 — never 5xx
cases.expected: 404 unknown; 400 malformed

cases.title: A user cannot read, change or delete another user's note
cases.expected: 401/403/404 each; note unchanged

cases.title: A burst of requests is throttled or handled — never 5xx
cases.expected: No 5xx; all 401/429; behaviour recorded
cases.notes: Live target returned 401 ×25 — no throttling observed.

cases.title: Logout revokes the token server-side
cases.expected: 401 with the revoked token

cases.title: Validation errors share one error envelope with no internals leaked
cases.expected: 4xx; strict error schema; no stack traces

cases.title: A malformed JSON body gets the same error envelope as any other 400
cases.expected: 400 with { success, status, message }

knownBugs.summary: Every Notes page is 502px wide in a 412px phone viewport — layout wrapper div#core is fixed at 500px.
POST /users/forgot-password answers unknown emails with 'No account found with the given email address' — account enumeration.
Malformed JSON returns 400 without the 'status' field and leaks the parser message.
